Class ScriptSimulation

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.ScriptSimulation
public final class ScriptSimulation extends Object
Simulation models written in Python or R (the modules bio7sim of Python and R). The script calls simulation(model) which starts a Java model of the same kind (a GridModel, ValueGridModel, AgentModel, GeoGridModel or GeoAgentModel): its init() and step() run the functions of the script in the embedded Python or R and display the state of the script with the displays of the Java models (ImageJ, the 3D view, the WorldWind globe). The settings and the buttons of the script are shown in the Settings view; the HTML export runs the script in the web browser (Pyodide or webR).
